scripts.typecheck: effect-tsgo tsrs --noEmit --project tsconfig.scripts.json && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error --config oxlint.config.mjs scripts packages/*/src packages/*/extensions packages/*/test apps/*/src apps/*/test apps/*/scripts apps/*/alchemy.run.ts apps/*/web/src apps/*/web/test
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --type-aware --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error --config oxlint.config.mjs --fix scripts packages/*/src packages/*/extensions packages/*/test apps/*/src apps/*/test apps/*/scripts apps/*/alchemy.run.ts apps/*/web/src apps/*/web/test
scripts.format: oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.mjs --check scripts .fallowrc.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.scripts.json vitest.config.ts && bun run --filter '*' format
scripts.format:fix: oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.mjs scripts .fallowrc.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.scripts.json vitest.config.ts && bun run --filter '*' format:fix
scripts.test: vitest run scripts && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.validate:fast: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run dead-code && bun run format && bun run ast-grep && bun run ast-grep:test && bun run test
scripts.validate:release: bun run validate:fast && bun run build && bash scripts/nix-smoke.sh
